metadata.quantum_depth_rationale: The task wraps a QNode for PyTorch training, but the main work is neural-network interface and parameter plumbing.

task.problem_statement: PennyLane has QML templates and PyTorch support, but users do not have a native way to wrap a QNode as a PyTorch neural-network layer. A QNode should be usable inside standard torch.nn modules and hybrid models while keeping its quantum weights trainable through PyTorch.
requirements: A Torch-compatible QNode layer must be available from the qnn module.
The layer must be constructible from a QNode and a mapping of QNode weight names to shapes.
The layer must behave as a torch.nn.Module and evaluate the wrapped QNode for single inputs and batched inputs.
Trainable QNode weights must be registered as PyTorch parameters with gradients populated by backpropagation.
The layer must be usable inside a larger torch.nn.Module together with classical layers.

interface.Name: TorchLayer
interface.Description: Wraps a PennyLane QNode as a PyTorch module with trainable QNode weights.

interface.Name: TorchLayer.forward
interface.Description: Evaluates the wrapped QNode for single or batched PyTorch inputs.
